notes: Steps D and E only; steps A-C and results_S1/paper_cards/S-686-33.json and parts/S-686-33_claim_updates.json belong to the lead session and were not touched. D: all 320 claims screened for overlap on nerve block, peroneal, sciatic, radicular, relief outlasting the block, lidocaine for neuropathic pain, disc herniation, sham-controlled design and author terms. Tajiri is named in exactly one claim in claims_all.json (D020, the lead's) and in none of the Notion pages. 5 claims re-judged (D026 D030 D033 D041 D057) plus 1 of the 49 wheal-page claims (W-R011), written to parts/S-686-33_other_claims.json with kind other-claim. No verdict changed. Most entries are guards: this is a randomised, double-blind, saline-controlled block in a neuropathic pain population, so it surfaces in searches for one, but its only post-block measurement is at fifteen minutes and it must not be counted toward any durability claim - the same exclusion the lead established for D020, now recorded for D026 and D057 as well. The one positive addition is W-R011, where it supplies a second counter-example to the broad form of 'nothing has ever been measured in neuropathic human skin after an injected local anaesthetic': a quantified pin-prick measurement in the affected distribution with a saline control and a blinded assessor. That agrees with the worker who recorded W-R011 as narrowed and is weaker than the intradermal counter-example already there, because the injection was perineural. Reference list worked: the existing Xavier 1988 entry (PMID 3269220) was kept untouched and one entry appended to parts/S-686-33_extra_studies.json - Selander and Sjostrand 1978, verified as PMID 726868, DOI 10.1111/j.1399-6576.1978.tb01346.x, which fills the PMID the paper card left deliberately blank and which splits by nerve compartment in a way that qualifies how the paper's spread assumption should be read. The remaining 14 references are book chapters, mechanism papers and a Japanese-language pain-scale paper, none of which decides any claim in claims_all.json; there is no claim in the file about antidromic or ectopic impulse generation.
